name: Otome no Susume ~Hatsumoude o Issho ni~
original_name: 乙女のススメ〜初詣を一緒に〜
source:
Two childhood friends are looking forward to this Christmas. But out of the blue both of them separately receive an invitation to visit a Shinto shrine on New Year's Eve. How will their trip go?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
